import bpy
chairs=[bpy.data.objects[f"Chair {i}"] for i in range(1,5)]
mat=bpy.data.materials.new("ChairRed"); mat.use_nodes=True
b=next(n for n in mat.node_tree.nodes if n.type=="BSDF_PRINCIPLED")
b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value=(0.6,0.02,0.02,1); mat.diffuse_color=(0.6,0.02,0.02,1)
for o in chairs:
    print(o.name,[s.material.name if s.material else None for s in o.material_slots],[s.link for s in o.material_slots])
    for s in o.material_slots:
        s.material=mat
print([o.name for o in bpy.data.objects if any(s.material and s.material.name=="ChairGrey" for s in o.material_slots)])
